name: obsidian-clarity-ledger
description: 《认知觉醒》工字格笔记法的 Obsidian 插件

scripts.build: npm run build:css && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),m=require('./manifest.json'),p=require('./package.json');m.version=p.version;fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json',JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n');const v=require('./versions.json');v[p.version]=m.minAppVersion;fs.writeFileSync('versions.json',JSON.stringify(v,null,2)+'\n')" && git add manifest.json versions.json && git commit -m "chore: v"
